Kind3.description: Cache family. Ordinary previews/probes keep their existing SQLite payload store.

oneOf.description: Existing small preview, probe and proxy cache (1 GiB maximum).
File-backed verified conversions (1 TiB maximum); choose a separate cache root.

max_bytes.description: Maximum payload bytes: artifacts up to 1 GiB, conform up to 1 TiB; index and decoded scratch are separate.

cache_root.description: Local cache directory used by cache.run

policy.description: Byte and entry budgets; least-recently-used derived entries are evicted until both are met.

tools.description: Return the JSON Schema for one command's arguments, including CLI-only commands, or for a shared type that tool listings abbreviate: project, operation, scene, template, audio_routing, transcript or captions. Large schemas come back as an outline of variants and definitions; pass select (for example operation + clip.append, or scene + Layer) for one part with everything it references. Read-only.

full.description: Return the whole schema even when it is large

name.description: A command such as `scene.render` or its MCP tool name, or a shared type: `project`, `operation`, `scene`, `template`, `audio_routing`, `transcript` or `captions`.

select.description: One part to return: a variant tag such as `clip.append`, or a definition name such as `Layer`

tools.name: cutbolt_schema

tools.description: Start a saved project at revision 0, from id/width/height/frame_rate or from a full snapshot. store_root must be an existing local directory. Retry with the same request_id and arguments to retrieve the original receipt.

frame_rate.description: New empty project frame rate, for example 25 or "30000/1001".

height.description: New empty project frame height in pixels, 1-8192.

anyOf.description: Versioned project snapshot: canvas, frame rate, media and either a sequential clip list or native tracks. Returned by project.create and session.get; change it only through operations. Abbreviated; cutbolt_schema {"name":"project"} returns it.

project.description: Valid snapshot saved as revision 0 of a new project

request_id.description: Caller-chosen ID for this change, 1-128 bytes, unique within the project. Resend identical arguments with it to retry safely.

store_root.description: Existing local directory holding the session database (projects.sqlite3)

width.description: New empty project frame width in pixels, 1-8192.

tools.name: cutbolt_session_create

tools.description: Read the saved head or a chosen immutable revision. Returns the full project. Get the head before editing; use a receipt revision for rendering.

project_id.description: ID of a project saved in store_root.

save_as.description: Write the result to this new workspace .json file and return a summary

store_root.description: Existing local directory holding the session database (projects.sqlite3)

tools.name: cutbolt_session_get

tools.description: Commit atomic edits against expected_revision. Retry request_id only with identical arguments. On REVISION_CONFLICT read and reconsider. Returns semantic changes. A clip scene saves a generated source or workspace recipe. project.working_space selects bits 8/16 and light encoded/linear; null restores the default.

expected_revision.description: Head revision this change was prepared against; a different head fails with REVISION_CONFLICT.

anyOf.description: Editing operations applied in order as one atomic batch; any failure commits nothing.

items.description: One edit in an atomic timeline.apply or session.apply batch, tagged by `op`; each must leave a valid project. The clip.* operations and timeline.ripple_delete edit the sequential `clips` list and are rejected once native tracks exist. Abbreviated; cutbolt_schema {"name":"operation"} returns it.

op.description: Variant tag; cutbolt_schema with select returns a variant's fields.

select.description: Optional dotted field or array-index path.

operations.description: Atomic edits, inline or selected from a workspace JSON file.

project_id.description: ID of a project saved in store_root.

request_id.description: Caller-chosen ID for this change, 1-128 bytes, unique within the project. Resend identical arguments with it to retry safely.

store_root.description: Existing local directory holding the session database (projects.sqlite3)

tools.name: cutbolt_session_apply

tools.description: Undo the latest applied state as a new revision, preserving history. Repeated undo walks backward. Retry with identical request_id/expected_revision.

expected_revision.description: Head revision this change was prepared against; a different head fails with REVISION_CONFLICT.

project_id.description: ID of a project saved in store_root.

request_id.description: Caller-chosen ID for this change, 1-128 bytes, unique within the project. Resend identical arguments with it to retry safely.

store_root.description: Existing local directory holding the session database (projects.sqlite3)

tools.name: cutbolt_session_undo

tools.description: Look up whether a request ID was committed, without resending its arguments. Returns the original receipt, or REQUEST_NOT_FOUND if it never took effect. Use after a lost response or restart before deciding to retry.

project_id.description: ID of a project saved in store_root.

request_id.description: Request ID of the change to look up.

store_root.description: Existing local directory holding the session database (projects.sqlite3)

tools.name: cutbolt_session_receipt

tools.description: Read newest-first revision summaries. limit defaults to 50 (1-200). Pass next_before_revision as before_revision for the next page; null means finished.

before_revision.description: Return entries older than this revision

project_id.description: ID of a project saved in store_root.

store_root.description: Existing local directory holding the session database (projects.sqlite3)

tools.name: cutbolt_session_history

tools.description: Read saved state, frame progress, attempt history and completion/error receipt. An exited worker triggers checked publication reconciliation or an opted-in retry within its saved limit. This can update internal job metadata but does not start a worker.

detail.description: summary, the default, shortens bulky parts (timing runs to one line per layer, lists to counts) and names them in the...

job_id.description: Job ID from the render.start ticket.

job_root.description: Job queue directory used with render.start

tools.name: cutbolt_job_status

tools.description: Request cancellation of a queued/running job without deleting final output. Poll until cancelled or completed; publication can win a simultaneous cancellation. Safe to repeat for the same job.

job_id.description: Job ID from the render.start ticket.

job_root.description: Job queue directory used with render.start

tools.name: cutbolt_job_cancel

tools.description: Reconcile saved publication and wake the queue worker to drain queued jobs, including explicitly opted-in interrupted retries within their saved attempt limit. Completed, cancelled and exhausted jobs are not rerun.

job_root.description: Job queue directory used with render.start

tools.name: cutbolt_job_resume

tools.description: Queue a long-running command in the background and return a durable ticket: export.run (H.264/AAC or lossless delivery), export.review (a review folder for a rendered cut), captions.render (generated caption edits or a compiled overlay), graphics.place (save a generated graphic clip in one edit), media.transcribe (a whole file's speech into transcripts, or a known script aligned to it), media.prepare (any camera or phone file to a timeline asset, optionally for a project's rate and size), media.conform, scene.render, audio.render, audio.repair.render, hdr.conform, image.sequence.compile, proxy.generate, preview.range, cache.run or transcript.transcribe. Arguments are prepared and validated now. Follow with job.wait or job.status; the result holds the command's receipt. Independent jobs run at once, so queue several, then wait for them all with one job.wait job_ids; job.cancel stops one.

arguments.description: That command's arguments exactly as for a direct call, without `command`; cutbolt_schema with its name gives the schema.

job_root.description: Existing local directory holding the job queue (jobs.sqlite3)

request_id.description: Caller-chosen ID unique within job_root, 1-128 bytes. An identical resubmission returns the original ticket.

run.description: Command to run in the background: graphics.place, export.run, export.review, captions.render, media.prepare, media.transcribe, media.conform, scene.render, audio.render, audio.repair.render, hdr.conform, image.sequence.compile, proxy.generate, preview.range, cache.run or transcript.transcribe.

tools.name: cutbolt_job_start

tools.description: Wait up to timeout_seconds (default 30, at most 120) for a queued or running job to finish, then return its status, progress and result, with finished true or false. With job_ids, wait for several jobs in one call, until all (default) or any have finished: the result counts jobs by status and lists each job's receipt, error or progress. Receipts are summaries unless detail is full.

Until.description: When a wait for several jobs returns: once `all` have finished, or as soon as `any` has.

detail.description: summary, the default, shortens bulky parts (timing runs to one line per layer, lists to counts) and names them in the...

job_ids.description: Several job IDs, up to 64, to wait for in one call

job_root.description: Job queue directory used with render.start or job.start

save_as.description: Write the result to this new workspace .json file and return a summary

until.description: With job_ids: return once all of them have finished (default) or as soon as any has.

tools.name: cutbolt_job_wait

tools.description: Find likely mistakes without rendering: flash frames, out-of-sync picture and sound, jump cuts, black or silent stretches, disabled-track clips, unused assets, missing or changed media (with input_root) and words cut by clip edges (with transcripts). Returns a text summary and findings; ok means no warnings or errors. Read-only.

input_root.description: Existing directory that project media paths resolve against

jump_window.description: A cut between touching clips of one source that skips or repeats less than this is a jump cut

min_clip_frames.description: Shorter picture clips are flash frames, 1-100 frames

project.description: Project to check. A full snapshot (cutbolt_schema {"name":"project"}), or {"project_id", "revision"} to load a saved revision (default the head; store_root defaults to the workspace store).

transcripts.description: Transcripts of the source media, as for timeline.outline

items.description: Content-bound transcript of one source range; returned by transcript.transcribe and edited by transcript.correct. Abbreviated; cutbolt_schema {"name":"transcript"} returns it.

tools.name: cutbolt_timeline_check

tools.description: List files and folders under input_root (the workspace by default), sorted, with sizes and paths relative to it, optionally recursive and filtered by extension; engine state folders are skipped. Read-only.

dir.description: Relative folder inside input_root to list

extensions.description: Only files with these extensions, such as `["mkv", "mp4", "wav"]`

recursive.description: Also list files in every subfolder

tools.name: cutbolt_files_list

tools.description: Probe a local source inside an explicit input_root. Returns its content identity (path relative to input_root, SHA-256, bytes), stream metadata and `timeline`: whether the file can go on a timeline as it is, with its exact frame rate, frames, rational duration and a media.add-ready asset, or the reasons it cannot and, for video, a normalization recipe with estimated cache bytes. Add original video with media.add and input_root to save automatic preparation for queued exports. A source longer than media.conform's 45000 output frames gets a reason instead of a shortened recipe.

path.description: Path of the file to probe; it must lie inside input_root.

tools.name: cutbolt_media_inspect

tools.description:
Run a command from the enum with its usual arguments. Prefer direct tools when listed. Routed commands never delete files or cancel jobs; use direct job.cancel/cache.prune. Long-running work uses job.start. cutbolt_schema returns complete arguments.
Editing: project, timeline, sessions and transcript assembly.
Media: source images, registry, proxy, conform and synchronization inspection.
Graphics: scenes, templates, installed fonts, captions, effects, tracking and stabilization.
Audio: levels, loudness, pause/filler edits, routing and recording inspection.
Delivery: render/export planning, interchange, portability and backups.

arguments.description: The command's arguments, without command; default none.

tools.name: cutbolt_run
